digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge comment echo reclaim (preparation phase)
propositions: Six reconciler-created duplicate Jira comment bodies (IDs 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, 997293) exist alongside six pre-existing survivors (963510, 963511, 963512, 963788, 963789, 964272) across three tickets, creating concentrated retained payload that must be deterministically removed via manifest-driven coordination

The preparation work must validate the exact two-live-copy pre-cleanup state, emit an immutable manifest binding ticket/body groups to Jira deletion IDs and survivors, and build supporting tools (Jira cleanup command, local history rewriter, runbook) that remain nonmutating and GET-only until explicit operator authorization

The coordinated execution sequence requires disabling GitHub Actions reconciler, freezing both Git and Jira state, deleting only the six manifest-enumerated rollout copies from Jira, removing their local COMMENT identities plus associated echo history and snapshots, verifying survivor and non-target parity, then re-enabling the workflow only after non-resurrection checks pass

The local Git rewriter must remove exactly the manifest-enumerated COMMENT/snapshot material plus the new epoch while preserving six surviving events, all unrelated paths, bridge bindings, signatures, topology, authorship, and reduced state; full replay, commit-map/topology/identity checks, retained-byte checks, and fsck must pass

Independent off-repository bundle restore and disposable exact-lease rollback/forward must be proven before any candidate publication, with zero push/update paths to authoritative refs and every precondition failure enforced before first external mutation

All preparation helpers, tests, linting, typechecking, and the project test gate must pass; the quiet-window execution ticket remains separate and blocked until all nine acceptance criteria are verified at the preparation landing checkpoint
